column highlights.color text null=NO default=-

column highlights.context jsonb null=YES default=-
column highlights.created_at timestamp with time zone null=YES default=now()
column highlights.favicon text null=YES default=-
column highlights.id text null=NO default=-
column highlights.length integer null=YES default=-
column highlights.pageTitle text null=YES default=-
column highlights.start integer null=YES default=-
column highlights.text text null=NO default=-
column highlights.timestamp bigint null=NO default=-
column highlights.url text null=NO default=-
column highlights.xpath text null=YES default=-
constraint highlights highlights_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
grant highlights anon DELETE

grant highlights anon TRUNCATE
grant highlights anon UPDATE

index highlights_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX highlights_pkey ON public.highlights USING btree (id)
index idx_highlights_timestamp CREATE INDEX idx_highlights_timestamp ON public.highlights USING btree ("timestamp" DESC)
index idx_highlights_url CREATE INDEX idx_highlights_url ON public.highlights USING btree (url)
relation highlights kind=r rls=false
relation highlights_pkey kind=i rls=false
relation idx_highlights_timestamp kind=i rls=false
